method: OSMnx graph_from_polygon on the matched-commune union boundary. Geofabrik morocco-260101.osm.pbf is retained as the archived Morocco extract for provenance; network construction uses the study-area polygon query.

integrity.turn_restriction_note: OSMnx drive graphs encode one-way restrictions on edges. Complex turn restrictions that require relation-level turn bans are not fully enforced by a simple directed graph representation.
